alt: Tashichho Dzong beside the Wang Chhu in Thimphu
transport: Private vehicle, driver and licensed guide throughout

stops.name: Thimphu

activities.match: Thimphu Sightseeing Tour with Simtokha Dzong on a Private basis

program.name: Thimphu
program.description: Days in the capital, with the Memorial Chorten, the Buddha Dordenma and Tashichho Dzong.

stops.name: Paro

activities.name: Hike to the Tiger's Nest
activities.match: Tigers Nest Trek | Bhutan on a Private basis
activities.description: The climb to Taktsang, the monastery wedged into a cliff nine hundred metres above the Paro valley floor.

program.name: Paro
program.description: Days in the valley below Taktsang, with Rinpung Dzong, the National Museum and the Tiger’s Nest hike.

day_titles.3: To Paro: Paro and Kyichu Lhakhang
day_titles.4: Ta dzong and rinpung dzong and tiger's nest hike

1: Arrival at Paro International and transfer to Thimphu
The road east along the Pa Chhu and the Wang Chhu
Check in and the rest of the day free
2: Breakfast, then out into the capital
The Memorial Chorten and the Buddha Dordenma
3: Breakfast, then west down the valley to Paro
Terraced fields and farmhouses the whole way
A guided round of the Paro valley
Kyichu Lhakhang, among the oldest temples in Bhutan
4: Breakfast, then out into the Paro valley
The round watchtower holding the National Museum
Rinpung Dzong on the slope above the river
The climb up the pine slope to Taktsang
The monastery wedged into the cliff face
5: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Paro International for your flight home

expert.name: Tenzin
expert.quote: Four nights and two valleys, flying both ways. The shortest Bhutan that still earns the trip.
expert.tip: With only four nights, skip Punakha and give the time to Paro. Taktsang the day after a travel day is a mistake.

summary: 5 days through Thimphu, Paro, with 4 nights, daily breakfast and a licensed Bhutanese guide: the thimphu sightseeing with simtokha dzong, the paro sightseeing with kyichu lhakhang, the ta dzong and rinpung dzong, the hike to the tiger's nest.
included: Included: 4 nights across Thimphu, Paro with daily breakfast; all land transfers by private vehicle; the Thimphu sightseeing with Simtokha Dzong; the Paro sightseeing with Kyichu Lhakhang; the Ta Dzong and Rinpung Dzong; the Hike to the Tiger's Nest; a licensed Bhutanese guide; permits and the sustainable development fee as quoted.
not_included: Not included: international and domestic flights; lunches and any meals not listed; monument entrance fees where not stated; travel insurance; personal expenses.
